author: claude
hook_line: Elephants can hear with their feet, and that is only the start of how strange they are.
intro: Elephants can hear with their feet, and that is only the start of how strange they are.
facts: Elephants talk in rumbles too low for us to hear, and those rumbles travel through the ground, so a herd can pick up messages through the soft pads of its feet from kilometers away.
The trunk has no bones and around forty thousand muscles, which lets an elephant lift a fallen log and then pick a single peanut off the floor with the tip.
They recognize themselves in a mirror, a test most animals fail, and when they find the bones of a dead relative they stop, go quiet, and gently touch them with their trunks.
A mother carries her baby for about 22 months, the longest pregnancy of any land animal, and the calf is born already weighing around 100 kilograms.
outro: Now you know why they never forget.
title_en: Elephants Hear With Their Feet and Mourn Their Dead
